drug_class: Antiviral (Direct-Acting Antiviral combination for Hepatitis C)
purpose: This medicine is used to treat chronic Hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection in adults. It works against all major types (genotypes) of Hepatitis C, making it very versatile. It is often used if you have been treated for Hepatitis C before with certain other medicines and still need more treatment.
how_it_works: This medication is actually three medicines combined into one pill, and each one attacks the Hepatitis C virus in a different way. Together, they block the tools the virus needs to copy itself and spread in your body. By working as a team, they can clear the virus from your body completely in most people.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects include headache, tiredness or fatigue, nausea, and diarrhea. Some people also experience trouble sleeping or feel generally unwell. Most of these side effects are mild and tend to go away on their own as your body adjusts.
warnings: Do not take this medicine if you are also taking a medication called rifampin, or certain cholesterol medicines like rosuvastatin, as serious interactions can occur. If you have hepatitis B as well as hepatitis C, tell your doctor right away because this medicine can cause hepatitis B to flare up and become dangerous. Always tell your pharmacist and doctor about every medicine, supplement, or herbal product you take before starting this medication.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one tablet taken by mouth once a day with food for 8 weeks. Taking it with a meal helps your body absorb the medicine properly. Always take it at the same time each day and do not skip doses, as this helps ensure the virus is fully cleared from your body.
